title: Education
description: Schooling past 18 (M2.8, D111–D114): who starts with a diploma, and the GED for those who don't. The college's terms and courses, and paying for them. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

diploma.description: In 10,000 eighteen-year-olds, those with a high school diploma: the state's four-year graduation rate (D112).

ged.description: The GED (M2.8 step 2): its subject tests, the price of each in cents, the test centre's hours, and what study does for the chance of passing.

pass.description: In 100 who sit it, those who pass, with no study of their own here.

perHour.description: Points on the chance of passing for each hour studied for the subject (tune).

most.description: The chance of passing at most, however long you study (tune).

college.description: The community college (M2.8 step 3): its terms, the courses toward an associate's, when they meet, and how grades are earned.

terms.description: When each term starts in the year, and its weeks of classes.

enroll.description: Days before a term starts that enrolling opens.

courses.description: The courses toward the associate's, taken in order.

slots.description: When a term's courses meet, the first course at the first slot: two days a week, an hour of the day, minutes a meeting.

study.description: Hours of study a week for each credit that a full grade asks (the rule of thumb's two).

grades.description: The least score, in 100, for each grade, highest first, with its points: the score is half attendance and half study done (tune).

gpa.description: The least grade point average for the associate's, in hundredths.

aid.description: Paying for the college (M2.8 step 4, D113): tuition and fees, the Pell grant by income against the poverty line, and federal Direct loans. Cents unless said. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

tuition.description: Tuition for a billable contact hour, in district. A course's contact hours are taken as its credits.

hourFee.description: Fees charged on each contact hour (technology and facilities).

termFee.description: Fees charged once a term (registration and student services).

most.description: The most a year, at full time.

least.description: The least awarded a year, at full time; nothing is paid below it.

line.description: The poverty line for a household of one, a year, from the year the award year uses.

full.description: Percent of the line at or under which the most is awarded.

none.description: Percent of the line above which nothing is awarded.

fullTime.description: Credits a term that count as full time; fewer are paid in proportion.

rate.description: The yearly interest rate, in hundredths of a percent.

fee.description: The origination fee, in thousandths of a percent of what is borrowed, taken before it is paid out.

half.description: Credits a term that count as half time: the least for a loan, and for not repaying while in school.

credits.description: Credits earned from which this year's limit applies.

year.description: The most borrowed in a year (two terms).

grace.description: Days after the last term before repayment starts.

leastMonth.description: The least monthly payment on the standard plan.
